# CorruptSetException

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public class CorruptSetException : InvalidOperationException
```

An existing Set on disk is not in a shape `extend` can read — for example a rich `nfty/NNNN.json` whose standards-pure `metadata/NNNN.json` sibling is missing. Names the offending file, so the user is not left guessing at a raw IO error.
